claims.text: The rooftop pool sits atop the seven-story hotel and has mountain views.

findings.quote: our tranquil rooftop pool sits atop our seven-story hotel and offers unparalleled views of the stunning mountain scenery.

claims.text: Juniper Table is the ground-floor eatery, with a counter-service bar for espresso and juice and a Cal-Med breakfast and lunch menu.

findings.quote: as is the ground-floor eatery Juniper Table
Downstairs, Juniper Table offers a counter-service bar for espresso and juice, a Cal-Med breakfast and lunch menu during the day

claims.text: Poolside, guests can order from High Bar, which serves cocktails and a casual menu of burgers, hummus plates and lettuce wraps.

findings.quote: For poolside eats, guests can order from High Bar's icy cocktails plus a casual all-day menu of burgers, hummus plates, and lettuce wraps.

claims.text: All rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and many have balconies.

findings.quote: All rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows, and many have balconies

claims.text: The hotel is steps from the main drag and within walking distance of most Palm Springs highlights, including shopping, dining, live music, hiking and museums.

findings.quote: you’re mere yards from the city’s bustling main drag and within walking distance of most of Palm Springs’ highlights—shopping, dining and live music, hiking, museums

claims.text: The hotel is family-friendly, with a dedicated kids' menu at High Bar.

findings.quote: the Rowan is family-friendly (check out the dedicated kids’ menu at the poolside restaurant High Bar)

claims.text: Pets are welcome regardless of size, weight or breed, at no extra charge.

findings.quote: We invite you to bring your pet no matter their size, weight, or breed, all at no extra charge.

claims.text: The roof deck is limited to hotel guests during the day and opens to the public in the evening.

findings.quote: The rooftop area is limited to hotel guests only during the day, but opens to the public come evening.

claims.text: The crew puts out complimentary coffee in the morning and hosts a free nightly wine hour.

findings.quote: the crew puts out complimentary coffee in the morning for guests and hosts a free nightly wine hour.

claims.text: The hotel has an outdoor venue with six pickleball courts, adjacent to the hotel and available exclusively for hotel guests.

findings.quote: This unique outdoor venue boasts six expansive pickleball courts (over 11,000 square feet) and an unforgettable atmosphere adjacent to our downtown hotel, available exclusively for hotel guests to enjoy.

claims.text: Rooms use tiled walls as headboards, with light-wood floors and framed topographical maps, a modern look that honors the city's midcentury roots.

findings.quote: The Rowan feels modern while still honoring the city’s midcentury roots and desert location, with rooms featuring light-wood floors, hairpin-legged nightstands, leather desk chairs, cool blue accent rugs, framed topographical maps, and the especially novel tiled walls serving as headboards.

claims.text: The King Spa Suite has balconies and soaking tubs set within its spa showers.

findings.quote: I loved the King Spa Suite, which, at more than 600-square-feet, comes with view-packed balconies and soaking tubs situated within the giant spa showers.

claims.text: 4 Saints is a rooftop restaurant and bar seven stories up that serves creative cocktails and California wines.

findings.quote: Seven stories above vibrant Palm Springs, 4 Saints serves creative cocktails, California wines
Signature restaurant 4 Saints shares the rooftop with the pool

claims.text: The hotel was built from the ground up as part of a downtown revitalization project that demolished a vacant old shopping center.

findings.quote: The 153-room hotel was built from the ground up as part of the of the (initially semi-controversial) downtown revitalization project that demolished a vacant old shopping center

claims.text: Those wanting a more private, off-the-beaten-path location will likely want to look elsewhere.

findings.quote: Those looking for a more private, off-the-beaten-path location will likely want to head elsewhere.

claims.text: Parking is valet and is included in the resort fee.

findings.quote: On-site parking is valet and is included in the Resort Fee

claims.text: The hotel has a mix of guests, often including many business travelers attending meetings and conferences, and travelers with pets.

findings.quote: often skews heavy on business travelers here for onsite meetings and conferences, as well as travelers with pets in tow
